api_checks.description: E1-S1 AC1 / F001: health returns 200 with body exactly {"status":"ok"} (backend at http://localhost:8000, public, unversioned)
E1-S1 AC2 / F004: evaluator asserts response header X-Correlation-ID equals abc-123
E1-S1 AC2 / F004: with no X-Correlation-ID request header, evaluator asserts the response header X-Correlation-ID is present and parses as a version-4 UUID

E1-S5 AC4 (auth: any authenticated user; api-contracts 1.1 error envelope): request without Authorization header is rejected with 401 UNAUTHENTICATED envelope, never 200. The 200/404 paths with a token are covered by pytest (F039, F040) because the login endpoint arrives in E1-S2.

layering.description: Types -> Config -> Repository -> Service -> API one-way dependencies (CLAUDE.md, .claude/architecture.md): backend/src/onboardx/domain imports nothing from services, repositories, controllers, fastapi or sqlalchemy; repositories do not import services or controllers; services do not import controllers. E3-S2 AC2 / F087: backend/tests/architecture/test_no_float_in_risk.py AST-scans domain/risk.py, repositories/models/risk.py, repositories/rule_set_repository.py and migrations/versions/0006_seed_rule_set_v1.py and finds zero float literals, float() calls and float annotations; the evaluator re-runs this test.

typing.description: Backend toolchain is venv + pip + backend/requirements.lock (DD-15; no uv). From backend/: `.venv/Scripts/python -m ruff check .` exits 0; `.venv/Scripts/python -m mypy src/` exits 0; `.venv/Scripts/python -m pytest --cov=onboardx --cov-report=xml --cov-fail-under=80` exits 0 on SQLite (deployment.md gate 5), with pytest-cov pinned in requirements.lock. Any skipped or xfail test mapped to a group-A feature in pytest_checks counts as a failure.

pytest_checks.description: Every group-A feature is proven by a named, passing pytest. The evaluator runs each listed file and confirms a test exercising the stated assertion exists and passes. Tests run against SQLite with all migrations applied via alembic upgrade head (deployment.md test env).

profile_state_code.description: DD-14 (amendments, group-A share only): migration 0001 defines case_profiles.state_code (nullable text, two uppercase letters when present; the required-for-IN validation is E1-S3, group C, not checked here). Migration 0006 seeds rule set v1 with a DOMESTIC_BORDER state list of exactly JK, PB, AS as string codes, and the RuleSet entity in domain/risk.py exposes that list. specs/design/data-models.md, data-models.schema.json, api-contracts.md and api-contracts.schema.json are amended to include profile state_code and the rule-set border-state list, matching migration 0001/0006.

frontend_toolchain.description: E1-S1 frontend scaffold (component-map). Node on this machine is v18.18.0: frontend/package.json pins Vite 5.x with a compatible @vitejs/plugin-react and vitest; `npm install` succeeds and `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) and `npm run build` pass under Node 18.18. Scaffold only; no pages are evaluated in group A.

folder_structure.description: Backend code lives under backend/src/onboardx/{config,controllers,domain,repositories,services} and tests under backend/tests/{unit,integration,architecture}, as in component-map.md. No application code outside these trees.

env_vars.description: E1-S1 AC4 / F007: Settings is a typed object loaded from environment variables; unset DATABASE_URL aborts startup with a message naming DATABASE_URL. No secrets or connection strings hardcoded in src/ (only .env.example carries sample values).

migrations.description: E1-S1 AC5, E1-S5 AC5, E3-S2 AC6: group-A migrations are exactly 0001_core_schema, 0002_append_only_triggers, 0004_seed_checklists_v1 and 0006_seed_rule_set_v1 (0003, 0005, 0007 belong to later groups); `alembic upgrade head` runs clean on an empty SQLite database; migrations/manifest.json lists each with its SHA-256 and the guard passes on the committed tree (F008, F009, F042). 0002 installs BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE triggers for state history and audit log (F034) and blocks UPDATE/DELETE of PUBLISHED risk_rule_sets (F089).
